newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells treasury bills worth $9.7 million.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells treasury bills worth $9.7 million.

text.p: The Bank of Mauritius sold all 200 million rupees ($9.7 million) worth of treasury bills at its weekly auction, the central bank said on Thursday.
The central bank sold 91-day bills worth 69.5 million rupees at a weighted average yield of 9.27 percent at the auction against 104.1 million rupees at 9.65 percent last week.

It sold 182-day bills worth 60 million rupees with an average yield of 9.43 percent against 177.7 million rupees at 9.98 percent last week. It sold 364-day bills worth 70.5 million rupees at an average yield of 9.71 percent against 168.2 million rupees at 10.04 percent last week.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 9.47 percent per annum from 9.93 percent last week, bank officials said.
